title-group.article-title: Drought reduces Vcmax in coffee seedlings

license.license-p: This article is distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.

abstract.p: Water deficit decreased net CO2 assimilation by 40% and the apparent maximum carboxylation rate (Vcmax) by 25% relative to well-watered plants.
Graphical abstract text that must be ignored.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Stomatal closure is the first response of many species to soil drying [1].
Whether biochemical limitation follows remains debated.

sec.title: Gas exchange
sec.p:
Under severe drought, stomatal conductance fell below 0.05 mol m-2 s-1. Net assimilation decreased by 40%.
Figure caption that must not appear in text.

sec.title: Fluorescence
sec.p: Maximum quantum yield of PSII (Fv/Fm) did not differ between treatments.
